guards.guard: og-4: a template classifies FORM only; it never fixes contextual nahw or sense
og-2: identical skeletons split by harakat (active/passive mu-participles); no vowel -> abstain
method transfers, conclusions do not; per-token class needs per-token evidence

a weak-substitution licence is TEMPLATE-SCOPED: licensing a hamza seat for the agent-participle template never licenses it inside the passive-participle or form-II-masdar shapes (a global table false-passes non-words)
a claimed penult surface mark is evidence only if it is WRITTEN on the surface's penult letter: unpointed evidences nothing, and a differing written mark refutes the claim
no weak realization is accepted without the exact bound declaration of which radical went weak in which position

a weak radical STANDING LITERALLY is a realization like any other and needs its own licence: an uncontracted hollow shape is a non-word, not a sound-root classification, so no template may treat an unaltered weak radical as regular by default
evidence must agree with itself: a declared weak position/radical that the supplied radicals do not bear refutes the evidence rather than decorating it
